hook.text: You spend $1,000 to acquire a customer. How many months until that customer has paid you back? That's payback period.

buildup.text: It's calculated as CAC divided by monthly revenue per customer. A $1,000 CAC with $100/month ARPU = 10 months.

discovery.text: Under 12 months is healthy for SaaS. Under 6 months is excellent. Above 18 months is a warning sign.

twist.text: Long payback periods drain cash. You're essentially lending customers money and waiting to be repaid.

climax.text: Short payback means faster reinvestment. Every dollar comes back sooner and can fund more growth.

punchline.text: Get your money back fast, then reinvest it faster.

quiz.question: What is a healthy CAC payback period for SaaS?
